name.full: Harvey - Conversational Front Door to Specter AI Agent Cluster

description.short: Chat with Specter AI agents for code analysis, defect investigation, and more
description.full: Harvey is the conversational front door to Specter's AI agent cluster. Tell Harvey what you need — defect root cause analysis (DARCI), code explanation (SCRIBE), implementation planning (PRISM), configuration lookup (HERMES), MySQL execution review (SENTRY), RCA reports (VERITAS), or client notes review for a release (NOTARY) — and Harvey will route your request to the right agent, gather the context needed, and deliver results right back to your Teams chat.

commands.title: explain
commands.description: Explain code — e.g. "explain the auth middleware in payments-api"

commands.title: plan
commands.description: Plan an implementation — e.g. "plan adding retry logic to the order service"

commands.title: lookup
commands.description: Look up configuration — e.g. "lookup connection pool settings for prod"

commands.title: review
commands.description: Review MySQL queries — e.g. "review slow queries on the orders table"

commands.title: rca
commands.description: Generate an RCA report — e.g. "rca for the March 5 checkout outage"

commands.title: notary
commands.description: Review client notes for a release — e.g. "notary 1.10.23"
